title: Walker: 'How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?'

tellings.quote: remember Walker saying, "We're talking about MJ12. Oh, the the dead bodies." He said, "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?"

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a talk he had around 1987 with Eric Walker, a man Cameron calls the head of the whole secret UFO effort. Cameron says that when he brought up MJ12, a group said to be a secret panel handling UFO matters, and the dead bodies said to come from crashes, Walker answered: "How do you know they're dead? You assume too many things and they're all wrong. How do you know they didn't get up and walk away?" If true, it would hint that beings from crashed craft lived.
